title: A case of the client contract of MIG-Ace

description.description: What the case shows, in one or two sentences.

script.description: The text of the script file, with its line endings.

parameters.description: The parameters of the run, in the order in which they are sent.

answers.description: What the database answers. The first entry answers the first statement that is sent, and so on. A statement without an entry succeeds without rows and without notices.

rows.description: The rows of the result. Only a guard query has some.

notices.description: Notices that the database sends while the statement runs.

error.description: The statement fails with this error, after its notices.

outcome.description: success: every statement was sent or skipped by a guard. failure: a statement or a guard failed. refused: the runner did not accept the script and sent nothing.

sent.description: The statements that reach the database, in order, parameters included.

notices.description: The notices that reach the caller, in order.

message.description: The exact message of the reported error.

code.description: The code of the database that the reported error carries.

mentions.description: Texts that the message of the error must contain, where its wording is left to the runner.
